title: When a Roof Leak Is an Emergency
description: Water in the hallway tonight is an emergency roof repair. A dry stain you found on a clear afternoon can wait for an inspection.
html:
Not every drip needs a crew after dark. The ones that do are the ones still bringing water in, or the ones with the roof open to the sky.

Call now

  • Water is actively dripping into a room, onto a panel, or through a ceiling that is sagging.
  • Shingles are gone and the deck or the underlayment is open.
  • A limb is on the roof or through it.

That is a tarp and a dry-in, then a repair or a replacement in daylight. The steps are on storm and emergency and in tarping a roof after a Texas storm. If the water is near electrical gear, keep people out of that room.

It can wait for a weekday

A stain that is dry, a drip that stopped when the rain stopped, or granules in the gutter with no leak inside. Those still need a look. They do not need a stranger on the roof at night. Start with the three spots that leak first so you can say what is above the stain, then roof repair. What that local visit should be is in what roof repair near me should mean.

If it is coming in now, call (281) 541-0027. If it can wait, request a free inspection.
